reviews.comment: I feel like he uses this time as a standup comedy hour. But he is organized, he designed the GEOG213 labs and assignments so he knows exactly how to help. It was a decent amount of work for a 1 credit lab, but I actually learned a lot. Class is only one day a week so definitely don't miss, the one time I missed he emailed me asking if I was okay
I really enjoyed the class. Offered feedback on my stuff throughout the semester that I would be submitting for the final projects.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: AJ is very nice and understanding. I found the content interesting, but even if you do not an A should be pretty easy because the labs were not graded hard. AJ is also good at answering questions and explained the content and instructions well. I bought a textbook for the class but never had to use it.
Very easy class. AJ is super nice and understanding. He is very helpful and makes labs straightforward and easy. Highly recommend
AJ is one of the best TAs in the program. He is easily accessible, understanding, and he teaches the content well. Definitely recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He made the information in the class fun because he was passionate about it. It's hard to get him as the instructor because I think the TA's are randomly assigned and when you register for 213 there are tons of sections. But if you get him, it'll be a great class. Beware of the pop quizzes, even though they aren't worth many points.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class
